newsitem.title: USA: Health Management holders approve merger.
newsitem.headline: Health Management holders approve merger.

text.p: Health Management Inc on Friday said its shareholders at a special meeting approved a proposed merger with Transworld HealthCare Inc.
Completion of the transaction requires approval of Transworld's senior lenders.
If the merger is not completed on or before July 31, Transworld and the company may terminate the merger agreement.

Health Management provides integrated pharmacy-management services to patients with chronic medical conditions and to health-care professionals, drug manufacturers and third-party payers involved in their care. Transworld Home provides alternate-site health-care services and products.
